catalog.title: Model list
catalog.hint: The models each runtime may use, the image flag and the effort key. A model used in the difficulty table or a role cannot be removed yet.
catalog.inUse: {{model}} is still used by {{agents}} agents and {{issues}} open issues.
catalog.idInvalid: The id may only contain letters, digits and . _ : / - , must start with a letter or digit, and is at most 100 characters.
catalog.idDuplicate: The model is already in the list.
catalog.full: Each runtime holds at most {{max}} models.

complexity.title: Difficulty table
complexity.hint: Each difficulty level has an order of runtimes to try and a model and effort per runtime. The runtime listed first is preferred.
complexity.largeLocked: The large level runs on Claude only: its fallback and retry-later flow is written for Claude.
complexity.lastRuntime: Each level needs at least one runtime.

roles.title: Default model per role
roles.hint: Changing a role default also changes every agent of that role that runs exactly the old model; hand-edited agents stay as they are.
roles.rootNote: Override when a Claude reviewer reviews a root issue.

upgrade.sectionHint: Replace an old model with a new one everywhere: the list, the difficulty table, roles, agents and open issues.
upgrade.title: Bulk model upgrade
upgrade.description: Pick the runtime, the old model and the new model. Press Preview to see how many places change.
upgrade.macWarning: Check that the new model runs on the Mac first (try it on one agent on the agent page). If the Mac lacks it, runs fail in bulk; to go back, upgrade the other way round.
upgrade.dirtyWarning: Unsaved changes on the page are discarded by the upgrade.
upgrade.toHint: Type a new id or pick an existing model of the runtime.
upgrade.catalogRenamed: Model list: the old model is renamed to the new one.
upgrade.catalogMerged: Model list: the old model is merged into the new one (already listed) and removed.
